items.title: Sub-half breadth cushioned by positive dealer gamma into a calm after-hours close
items.note: Market breadth has slipped well below its broad-market threshold (heatmap 49.85% positive vs 60%, margin -10.15, narrow leadership) at the same time SPY dealer gamma is positive (signedNetGEX +$3.69B, spot 772.35 above the 770.19 flip, call wall 775 / put wall 770) and the closing intraday tape is a two-sided Reversal risk auction (VWAP 772.74). Fewer than half of constituents are participating while a pinning, move-dampening dealer structure holds, yet the bench still reads bull-stacked (SPY 772.49, +10.08% vs 200d) and the regime is calm (band 'VIX 14.6', VIX 14.55, score 1). Structurally this is a pin-cage over fragile internals — narrow leadership whose downside is temporarily muffled by positive gamma rather than a broad, healthy advance. It is an emergent cross-tool divergence, not any single owner read; the cushion lapses and the read flips to break-watch if spot loses the 770.19 flip.
items.method: Cross-tool divergence flag: compare market-heatmap-lab breadthPct against its own 60% broad threshold (sign of the margin), then overlay the options-structure / gamma-trading dealer-gamma sign together with spot-versus-flip position and the intraday-tape session type. Raise the pattern only when breadth is below threshold AND dealer gamma is positive AND spot sits above the flip (pinning), all against a calm VIX band and a bull-stacked bench — flagging a suppressed-volatility cushion over narrow internals, and inverting to break-watch once spot falls below the flip.
inputs: market-heatmap-lab: breadthPct 49.85, threshold 60, margin -10.15, 134 constituents, leadership narrow
options-structure-lab: signedNetGEX 3691718781.4616, flipLevel 770.19, spot 772.35, callWall 775, putWall 770, expectedMove 4.14
gamma-trading-lab: regime positive, scenario pin-to-maxpain, conviction patient, flip 770.19
intraday-tape-lab: sessionType 'Reversal risk', control Algo-controlled, vwap 772.74, gapPct 0.55
regime band 'VIX 14.6' (vix 14.55, score 1); bench SPY 772.49 bull-stack (+3.32% vs 50d, +10.08% vs 200d)

items.title: Two-horizon technology concentration as market breadth thins below half
items.note: Leadership is concentrating into technology across two independent horizons even as broad participation drops under half: the short-horizon sector RRG rotates into XLK (Improving quad, rsMom6m +20.6) while the long-horizon 6M ETF-momentum ranking is led by VGT at 30.3% with QQQ also in the top five — both technology-tilted — at the same time market-heatmap breadth sits well below its 60% threshold (49.85%, margin -10.15). Two methods that do not share code agree the tape is being carried by tech, and the sub-half breadth says fewer names are along for the ride. That combination — cross-horizon tech leadership plus thinning breadth — is a concentration signal rather than a broadening one, and it raises single-sector fragility if the tech bid stalls.
items.method: Cross-horizon concentration check: intersect the sector-research-lab rotation target (into-ticker with its RRG quad and rsMom6m) with the etf-momentum-lab 6M leader and top-five membership, then gate on market-heatmap-lab breadth being below its broad threshold. Raise the pattern only when the short-horizon sector rotation and the long-horizon momentum leader point at the same theme (technology here) AND breadth is sub-threshold, marking leadership as concentrating rather than broadening.
inputs: sector-research-lab: into XLK, rrgState 'Improving', rsRatio 99.99, rsMom 103.53, rsMom6m 20.6, accel 5.72
etf-momentum-lab: leader VGT signal 30.3, horizon 6M, risk balanced; QQQ in top five (signal 18.63)
market-heatmap-lab: breadthPct 49.85, threshold 60, margin -10.15, leadership narrow
regime band 'VIX 14.6' (vix 14.55, score 1); bench SPY 772.49 bull-stack
